definitions.explanation: Vegetables preserved by pickling in salt, rice bran, vinegar, sake lees, or miso.

examples.japanese: {漬物|つけもの}は{日本|にほん}の{食事|しょくじ}に{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: Pickles are essential to Japanese meals.

examples.japanese: {自家製|じかせい}の{漬物|つけもの}を{作|つく}っています。
ご{飯|はん}のお{供|とも}に{漬物|つけもの}がある。
examples.english: There are pickles as a side dish for rice.
examples.notes: ご飯のお供 means accompaniments for rice

notes:
Major types of Japanese pickles:
- {糠漬|ぬかづ}け (rice bran pickles)
- {塩漬|しおづ}け (salt pickles)
- {醤油漬|しょうゆづ}け (soy sauce pickles)
- {味噌漬|みそづ}け (miso pickles)
- {酢漬|すづ}け (vinegar pickles)
- {粕漬|かすづ}け (sake lees pickles)

Common vegetables: {大根|だいこん} (daikon), きゅうり (cucumber), {白菜|はくさい} (napa cabbage), なす (eggplant).

Also called お{新香|しんこ} or お{香々|こうこ} (おこうこ) in polite speech.
